def VTask.sumLexLift : {α₁ : Type u_1} -> {α₂ : Type u_2} -> {β₁ : Type u_3} -> {β₂ : Type u_4} -> {γ₁ : Type u_5} -> {γ₂ : Type u_6} -> (f₁ : α₁ → β₁ → Finset γ₁) -> (f₂ : α₂ → β₂ → Finset γ₂) -> (g₁ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₁) -> (g₂ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₂) -> α₁ ⊕ α₂ → β₁ ⊕ β₂ → Finset (γ₁ ⊕ γ₂)
  := fun {α₁ α₂ β₁ β₂ γ₁ γ₂} f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ a b =>
    match a, b with
    | inl a₁, inl b₁ =>
      -- Case: a is inl a₁, b is inl b₁
      (f₁ a₁ b₁).image (fun c₁ => inl c₁)
    | inl a₁, inr b₂ =>
      -- Case: a is inl a₁, b is inr b₂
      (g₁ a₁ b₂).image (fun c₁ => inl c₁) ∪ (g₂ a₁ b₂).image (fun c₂ => inr c₂)
    | inr a₂, inl b₁ =>
      -- Case: a is inr a₂, b is inl b₁
      ∅
    | inr a₂, inr b₂ =>
      -- Case: a is inr a₂, b is inr b₂
      (f₂ a₂ b₂).image (fun c₂ => inr c₂)
